sections.en: Solana is changing hands near $120.21, -0.15% over the past 24 hours and +1.12% on a 7-day view. Spot trades above the 50-day average ($106.10) and above the 200-day average ($97.65), keeping the medium-term structure constructive. The 30-day tape reads as a recovery phase (+16.46%), suggesting the market is still repairing.

sections.en: Total market capitalization stands near $70.7B (CoinGecko). Reported 24-hour spot volume is $2.42B with 7-day average turnover subdued versus the trailing month (0.81x) . Note: the sentiment reading above is the public alternative.me series; proprietary on-chain datasets are still left out rather than estimated. The alternative.me Fear & Greed gauge prints 73 (Greed).

**Derivatives positioning.** The public Binance futures endpoints did not answer for this asset on this cycle, so rather than fabricate a view the desk flags it as a **data gap**: funding and open-interest extremes remain the standard trigger for squeeze dynamics in Solana.

**Trend structure.** Across horizons the picture is perfect bullish alignment (price > EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200), the textbook configuration of a trend-following regime where pullbacks into the 20-day mean tend to be bought. Spot at $120.17 versus EMA20 $115.76, EMA50 $106.10 and EMA200 $97.65 frames the medium-term bias mechanically rather than emotionally. From this configuration the desk's working assumption is that trend-following exposure is only justified while price holds the side of the 50-day average it currently occupies.

**Key levels.** The operational map reads: initial support at $119.65 (recent swing low); the lower Bollinger band $103.70 as the 2σ downside envelope; first resistance at $121.43 (recent swing high); upper band $128.70 as the stretch target. Levels derived from the last ~60 sessions of closes are guides for location, not promises of reaction; they mark where prior two-way business was done and therefore where resting liquidity is most plausible. ATR(14) of $4.274 implies a typical daily range of roughly 3.6 percent of spot, which is the unit of risk to size positions against.

**Momentum.** RSI(14) prints 62.9 — neutral territory; MACD (12/26/9) sits below its signal line (4.766 vs 5.224, histogram -0.4589), consistent with fading momentum. Momentum readings are state descriptors, not trade signals on their own; the desk treats confluence between momentum and level location as the actionable unit.

**Volatility & liquidity.** 30-day realized volatility annualizes near 60%; the 20-day band spans 22% of the mid — expanded, which favors trend continuation tactics; 7-day turnover runs at 0.81x the trailing-month norm. Behavior around these regimes — absorption at band edges, volume confirmation on breaks — is what separates a tradeable move from noise.

**Performance context.** On longer windows the asset has returned +16.46% over 30 days and +49.00% over 90 days. Positioning decisions made on monthly horizons should respect these base rates instead of extrapolating the last week. The 7-session change (+1.12%) is the shortest window the desk treats as signal rather than noise.

sections.en:
**Bullish scenario.** Continuation higher requires acceptance above $121.43 on expanding turnover; continued holds of the 50-day average ($106.10); RSI holding above 60 (currently 63). Under those conditions the path of least resistance flips to buy-the-dip, with prior resistance converting to support as the confirmation test.

**Bearish scenario.** Downside continuation triggers on a decisive loss of $119.65. In that case failed support typically becomes the new ceiling, and momentum chasers provide the exit liquidity.

Net take on Solana: spot $120.21 with the medium-term bias constructive while price holds the relevant side of the 50-day average. The 24-hour tape (-0.15%) is consistent with that bias. Decision zones are the levels named in the technical section, not opinions: trade the reaction at those prices, not the headline of the day.
